overview_description.description:
Rebtel aims to solve the problems that any migrant encounters when crossing a border, whether fleeing for something or racing towards something better: communications, work and banking problems.

Led by top management from Kinnevik group companies with it’s strong tradition of disruption through technology, Rebtel provides a technical platform for communication, money transfer and even work for its users through an innovative, fast growing independent work program Activist.

Founded in Stockholm, Sweden, - home to the second largest group of Unicorns in the world - Rebtel is a profitable company that employs  85 high performing employees representing over 35 nationalities.

product.name: International Calling Service
product.description: A service that enables users to make international phone calls at reduced rates by connecting calls through local phone lines.

product.name: Mobile Top-Up Service
product.description: A service that lets users send mobile phone credit or data to friends and family in other countries quickly and securely.

product.name: International Money Transfer Service
product.description: A service that allows users to send money internationally at low rates for purposes such as gifts, bills, or financial support.

product.name: International Calling Cards
product.description: Prepaid calling cards that provide users with a set amount of minutes for international calls at fixed rates without hidden fees.

product.name: Rebtel Bus Service
product.description: A mobile service that provides free calls to Cuba by allowing users to access a bus equipped with calling facilities in Miami.
